name: Edit a video
about: You have footage of a long-form video (16:9). The agent cuts the rough, you approve and lock the talk, it dresses it with overlays and captions, checks it, and you export.

stages.title: Brief
stages.focus: This is a long-form edit (1920x1080). Ask about the length they want, what must stay, what can go, and the look of overlays and captions.

stages.title: Rough cut
stages.focus: Make the rough cut from the footage in video/footage. In order: transcribe each recording once (transcribe.py, verbatim and aligned), scan.py, write video/out/edl.json with a cut_before on every cut (flag the judgment calls with an ask), joins.py check then snap until no word is clipped, build_rough.py, then handover.py (rough.json, rough-words.json, cuts.json with Before/After clips). Transcription, the build and the handover run in the background. Report the length before and after and the cuts by kind.

stages.title: Rough review
stages.focus: The user watches the rough and goes through the Cuts list (Keep / Restore / Note). Approve & lock hashes edl.json and rough.mp4: the talk is fixed from here.

stages.title: Visuals
stages.focus: Dress the locked rough: write video/out/events.json (overlays, zooms, captions, sounds) with the Events builder, times only from rough-words.json, then run.py --proof for a cheap look, fix what is off, and run.py --final (in the background). Never touch edl.json or rough.mp4. Report the overlays by kind and the render times.

stages.title: Inspect
stages.focus: Run check_cut.py (length, frames, locked files, voice) and look at video/out/frames.jpg. Check the captions against the words, that no overlay covers what the screen is showing, and that the pace has no long stretch with nothing changing.

stages.title: Final review
stages.focus: The user watches final.mp4. Sending it back goes to Visuals: the talk stays locked.

stages.title: Export
stages.focus: MP4, SRT captions, FCPXML and OTIO from the Export tab.
